title: Decision record frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a decision record in docs/decisions/NNNN-slug.md. The filename carries the decision number, so the frontmatter does not repeat it.

date.description: When the decision reached its current status.

status.description: proposed: open for comment; accepted: in force; rejected: considered and declined; deprecated: no longer applies; superseded: replaced by the decisions in superseded_by.

consulted.description: Whose opinion was sought before deciding.

informed.description: Who is kept up to date on the decision.

superseded_by.description: Decisions that replace this one. Required once the status is superseded.

decisionId.description: A decision's four-digit number, the prefix of its filename, as a string so leading zeros survive.

date.description: A calendar date in ISO 8601 form, YYYY-MM-DD.
